');
 background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-color:#133669;
 image-rendering:pixelated;border-top:2px solid #b1cde3}
.bf25-post-text{align-content:center!important;flex:1 1 auto!important}
.bf25-post-bottom .bf26-social-icon{width:21px;height:21px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.bf25-post-bottom .bfpx-icon{width:18px;height:18px}
@media(max-width:780px){.bf25-post-visual{height:115px}}
/* Diagnóstico previo: 5 publicaciones ficticias con arte e iconos pixelados. */
.publication-art{border:2px solid #51b6dc!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:3px 3px #051b3b!important;image-rendering:pixelated!important;object-fit:cover!important}
.publication-engagement svg{display:none!important}
.publication-engagement span{display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
.publication-engagement span::before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:20px;height:20px;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}
.publication-engagement span:nth-child(1)::before{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACQAAAAkCAYAAADhAJiYAAAAi0lEQVR4nO2X0QmAMBBDT+dzIEdwIPervxU82thUIuT9yp3hFUoaYX7Gkn0o21EeB849nWHsWZHlXyAX6KYt05sOJ9pH9sgZkgu0oHpnI2fIgVo4UIuhi5EWwhcjAFw/aD92/XhJV/tjHV9P25QzJBcIKuwRvFaZIWdILhB8ZDWst1uNnCG5QMaY2VzZNycBRf2grQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==')}
.publication-engagement span:nth-child(2)::before{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACQAAAAkCAYAAADhAJiYAAAAfklEQVR4nO2XQQqAMBADu+IH/J4P9Hs+oZ6ERdDs0tbmkDl58DAkZKFWHMdZa5nAvpnd38sMgS8khJAQYo385FfQQmTFdAnRCYUq82SPZ7ZuuoQkhJAQIr2yXkfyDbqE6ISGHMaWWukSohPSyhB0QqHK/nyv0SVEJySEEOLBBVzaFK+ze8auAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC')}
.publication-engagement span:nth-child(3)::before{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACQAAAAkCAYAAADhAJiYAAAAbUlEQVR4nO3WMQ6AIBBEUTAWFt7/pBZ22FJoVqNrPsl/HRQy2QmRUjSYmvHRbW/tbH9danje9H2cd3CBUirrPa0PNyFcoPTKenfqw00IF2juF1cj/RNuQrhA3rIILpD/sggukC/GCC6QJEmjOwAKsRwROnXsOwAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==')}
/* V32: todos los estados de privacidad e identidad legibles y pixelados. */
.onboarding-dialog,.onboarding-dialog.consent-dialog{background:#09285f!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;
 border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:5px 5px 0 #010e2e!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
.onboarding-dialog h2,.onboarding-dialog p,.onboarding-dialog label,.onboarding-dialog strong,
.onboarding-dialog .consent-copy{color:var(--bf-white)!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
.onboarding-dialog h2{color:var(--bf-yellow)!important;font-weight:900!important;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #061436!important}
.onboarding-dialog .onboarding-mark{background:#15437e!important;color:var(--bf-yellow)!important;border-radius:0!important;border:2px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important}
.onboarding-dialog .consent-copy p{font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,14px)!important;line-height:1.5!important;color:#e6f1ff!important}
.onboarding-dialog .consent-copy p strong{color:var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.onboarding-dialog .onboarding-btn{background:#103c7d!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;border:2px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #010e30!important}
.onboarding-dialog .onboarding-btn.button-confirm{background:var(--bf-yellow)!important;color:var(--bf-ink)!important;border-color:#fff0a7!important}
.onboarding-dialog .onboarding-btn.button-confirm:disabled{opacity:.57!important}
.onboarding-dialog .consent-checkbox{background:#0d3978!important;border-color:#2aaada!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important}
.onboarding-dialog .identity-display{color:var(--bf-yellow)!important;text-shadow:2px 2px #061536!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important}
.onboarding-dialog .avatar-bubble,.onboarding-dialog .identity-avatar-stage{border-radius:0!important}
.onboarding-dialog .avatar-bubble{border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;background:#1b4584!important;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #021033!important}
.onboarding-dialog .avatar-bubble img{image-rendering:pixelated!important}
.identity-regenerate{display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;border-radius:0!important;min-width:40px!important;min-height:40px!important}
.identity-regenerate svg{display:none!important}
.identity-regenerate::before{content:'';display:block;width:24px;height:24px;background:url('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACQAAAAkCAYAAADhAJiYAAAAbUlEQVR4nO3WMQ6AIBBEUTAWFt7/pBZ22FJoVqNrPsl/HRQy2QmRUjSYmvHRbW/tbH9danje9H2cd3CBUirrPa0PNyFcoPTKenfqw00IF2juF1cj/RNuQrhA3rIILpD/sggukC/GCC6QJEmjOwAKsRwROnXsOwAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==') center/contain no-repeat;image-rendering:pixelated}

/* V37: escenas pixel art de campaña por ID (no asignadas por técnica).
   Todas las imágenes se empaquetan como base64 en el HTML autocontenido. */
.bf37-rumor-art,.bf37-result-art,.bf37-video-art,.bf37-card-art,.bf37-end-art{
 display:block!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important;background-position:center!important;
 background-size:contain!important;background-color:#132d63!important;
 image-rendering:pixelated!important;image-rendering:crisp-edges!important;
 border:2px solid #48bde7!important;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #04122d!important;
}
.bf24-option .bf37-rumor-art{width:min(100%,350px)!important;height:clamp(85px,12vh,154px)!important;
 margin:7px auto 9px!important;flex:0 0 auto!important}
.bf24-option .bf24-option-title{display:block!important;width:100%!important}
.bf24-option .bf24-option-quote{display:block!important}
.bf24-option,.bf24-option.b{min-height:unset!important;justify-content:flex-start!important}
.bf24-result .bf37-result-art{width:min(100%,440px)!important;height:clamp(135px,23vh,228px)!important;margin:8px auto 14px!important}
.bf37-original-row{display:flex!important;gap:13px!important;align-items:stretch!important;margin:4px 0 12px!important}
.bf37-original-row .bf37-video-art{width:clamp(125px,18vw,235px)!important;min-height:96px!important;flex:0 0 auto!important}
.bf37-original-row .bf25-original{margin:0!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;justify-content:center!important;flex:1!important}
.bf37-card-art.bf25-post-visual{display:block!important;background-position:center!important;
 background-size:cover!important;height:clamp(78px,11vh,110px)!important;min-height:78px!important;
 border:0!important;border-top:2px solid #aac9dc!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.bf37-end-art{width:min(100%,460px)!important;height:clamp(155px,23vh,240px)!important;margin:0 auto 9px!important}
.bfmvp-story-result:has(.bf37-end-art){gap:10px!important;padding:clamp(16px,2.5vw,31px)!important}
.bfmvp-story-result:has(.bf37-end-art) h1{margin:0!important}
.bfmvp-story-result:has(.bf37-end-art)>p:not(.bfmvp-story-label){margin:4px 0!important}
@media(max-width:700px){
 .bf24-options{gap:12px!important}
 .bf24-option,.bf24-option.b{padding:12px!important}
 .bf37-original-row{gap:7px!important}
 .bf37-original-row .bf37-video-art{width:98px!important;min-height:80px!important}
 .bf37-card-art.bf25-post-visual{height:100px!important}
 .bfmvp-story-result .bf37-end-art{height:170px!important}
}
@media(max-width:420px){
 .bf24-option .bf37-rumor-art{height:115px!important}
 .bf37-original-row .bf37-video-art{width:76px!important;min-height:70px!important}
 .bf37-card-art.bf25-post-visual{height:94px!important}
}
